# Desktop and macOS surfaces (20)

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/<name>`. Import: `@/components/ballmac/<name>`. Names in parentheses are the exports.

- **app-window** (AppWindow, AppWindowTitleBar, AppWindowControls, AppWindowContent): The window chrome of a real desktop app (Tauri or Electron): a title bar that drags the window, double-click to maximize, and the controls the platform draws: traffic… Not for: Landing-page mockups of a Mac app (use mac-window).
- **control-center** (ControlCenter, ControlTile, ControlCluster, ControlRow, ControlSlider, ControlNowPlaying): The macOS Control Center panel in frosted glass: toggle tiles with round badges, grouped Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and AirDrop rows, pill sliders with the icon in the track, and… Not for: Full settings pages (use field, switch, slider).
- **desktop-icons** (DesktopIcons): A macOS desktop of icons: box-select with the pointer, drag to move with snapping to grid cells, double-click or Return to open, arrow keys to move focus and Alt plus… Not for: Ordinary file lists (file-browser).
- **dock** (Dock, DockItem, DockSeparator): A macOS-style dock whose icons grow with spring physics as the pointer approaches and push their neighbors apart. Not for: Primary navigation with many text links (use a header or sidebar).
- **dynamic-island** (DynamicIsland, DynamicIslandView, islandSpring): A black pill or MacBook-style notch that morphs between live activities (timers, uploads, an AI thinking state, notifications) with a spring layout animation. Not for: Several notifications that need to stay visible together (use notification-stack).
- **finder-window** (FinderWindow): A working mini Finder: sidebar shortcuts, back and forward history, icon and list views, search, click, shift and command selection, keyboard navigation and a path bar… Not for: A real file manager for your app (file-browser).
- **hud** (Hud, useTransientHud): The macOS volume and brightness HUD: a dark frosted square with a big icon and a 16-segment bar, or a slim capsule with a smooth bar. Not for: Toasts and messages (toast).
- **launchpad** (Launchpad): The macOS Launchpad: a frosted full-area overlay with search, pages of app icons sized to fit, page dots, wheel and key paging, arrow-key focus across pages and Escape… Not for: Command palettes (command).
- **lock-screen** (LockScreen): A full-screen lock screen in two flavors: macOS (live clock, avatar, password field that shakes when wrong) and iOS (clock, notification stack, flashlight and camera… Not for: Real authentication: the password prop is for demos, check credentials on a server.
- **mac-context-menu** (MacContextMenu, MacContextMenuTrigger, MacContextMenuContent, MacContextMenuItem, MacContextMenuCheckboxItem, MacContextMenuRadioGroup, …): A right-click menu styled like macOS: frosted panel, accent-color highlight, key equivalents, checkmarks, submenus and a red destructive item, on Radix for full keyboard… Not for: Standard product UI (context-menu).
- **mac-icons** (FolderIcon, FileIcon, DriveIcon, AppIcon): Resolution-independent macOS-style icons drawn in SVG and CSS: folders, documents with extension badges, drives and gradient app icons in eight theme-aware colors. Not for: Small UI glyphs (use lucide-react icons).
- **mac-window** (MacWindow, MacWindowContent, MacWindowControls, MacWindowMain, MacWindowSidebar, MacWindowSidebarItem, …): macOS window chrome: traffic lights whose glyphs appear on hover, a centered title or unified toolbar, an optional translucent sidebar with vibrancy, and active and… Not for: Modal dialogs in a web app (use dialog).
- **menu-bar** (MenuBar, MenuBarCheckboxItem, MenuBarClock, MenuBarContent, MenuBarGroup, MenuBarItem, …): A translucent macOS menu bar on Radix Menubar: a bold app menu, menus with key equivalents, submenus and checkmarks, a status area with icon buttons and a hydration-safe… Not for: Site navigation for a marketing page (use a header with links).
- **notification-stack** (Notification, NotificationStack): macOS Notification Center cards: collapsed, the newest sits in front with two peeking behind; click or press Enter to spring the stack open. Not for: Transient feedback after a single action (use a toast).
- **segmented-control** (SegmentedControl, SegmentedControlItem): A macOS segmented control: mutually exclusive options with a selected pill that springs between segments and hairline dividers between unselected ones. Not for: Switching between panels of content with their own semantics (use tabs).
- **sheet-dialog** (SheetDialog, SheetDialogTrigger, SheetDialogContent, SheetDialogHeader, SheetDialogTitle, SheetDialogDescription, …): A macOS sheet: a frosted panel that drops from the top edge of its window and dims only that window, with a default accent button, on Radix Dialog for focus trapping and… Not for: General modals (dialog).
- **spotlight-search** (SpotlightSearch, SpotlightSearchDialog, SpotlightSearchEmpty, SpotlightSearchFooter, SpotlightSearchGroup, SpotlightSearchInput, …): A macOS Spotlight-style command palette on cmdk: a large translucent search field, grouped results with app-icon tiles, fuzzy filtering and arrow-key navigation, inline… Not for: A plain search field for a results page (use input).
- **toolbar** (Toolbar, ToolbarButton, ToolbarGroup, ToolbarSegmented, ToolbarSegment, ToolbarSeparator, …): A frosted macOS toolbar with a title block, icon and labeled buttons, segmented view switches, an expanding search field, separators and spacers, built on Radix Toolbar… Not for: Page navigation (navbar).
- **widgets** (Widget, WeatherWidget, CalendarWidget, BatteryWidget): Desktop widgets in three sizes: weather with a sky gradient, hourly strip and daily ranges; a calendar with a month grid and events; a battery widget with rings. Not for: Interactive charts (chart).
- **window-manager** (WindowManager): A desktop of real windows: focus raises, the title bar drags, edges and corners resize, double-click zooms, the yellow light tucks a window into a tray, and Alt plus… Not for: Fixed split layouts (resizable).
